description: This file contains the PHP class OrderStatus which is a controller within the OpenCart admin panel responsible for managing order statuses. It provides methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting order statuses, handling HTTP requests, rendering views, and managing pagination.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Controller class responsible for administrative management of order statuses, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting order status entries in the database.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of order statuses with sorting and pagination controls.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request for listing order statuses, applies sorting, paging, and renders the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list data of order statuses including sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Renders the form for creating or editing an order status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions for adding or updating an order status, returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected order statuses based on request parameters, with permission checks.
